items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: YoRHa gauge on Base UI Progress: 14 px (sm 10 px) framed track, solid 6 px ink cells on an 8 px pitch over 2 px hairline ticks for empty cells, whole-cell fill edge, tabular value on the label baseline. Determinate increases glide with a 240 ms clip-path (--yorha-ease-out); indeterminate is a smooth 1.4 s linear sweep under the static cell mask (reduced: opacity pulse; off: static alternate cells). Props: size, status (active | paused | error), ticks, formatValue.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The gauge seams are a CSS gradient; no original assets are used. v4: indeterminate easing is --yorha-step-loop (was --yorha-ease-emphasized; reduced keeps the eased pulse); new props variant and formatValue. Increases animate with clip-path only (never width). v4 craft pass (breaking): `variant` (segments | dots) and `segments` are removed; the gauge is one cell design. Migration: drop `variant`/`segments`; use `size="sm"` for the compact bar, `status` for paused/error, `ticks` for 25/50/75 notches. The component now snaps its own width to a whole number of cells (at most one pitch of slack on the right) and exports `Gauge` (used by Meter). Motion is never stepped: no --yorha-step-* easings; the cell look is a static mask over the moving fill.
